recentItems.title: Fashion designer Bob Mackie, who made stars sparkle, dies at 87
recentItems.description: The legendary fashion and costume designer Bob Mackie, who dressed divas from Cher to Diana Ross in glittering, eye-catching designs, has died at age 87.

recentItems.title: This Chinese sneaker brand brought Steph Curry to China
recentItems.description: Stephen Curry has arrived in Beijing, months after he announced a partnership between his signature brand and Li-Ning in June that ended his sneaker free agency in a major win for the Chinese sportswear giant.

recentItems.title: When is it time to stop tracking your kids? | Terms of Service
recentItems.description:
Location tracking tools allow parents to check on their kids at any moment. A new poll finds that even as kids grow into young adults, the tracking often continues. When should it end? The University of Michigan's Sarah Clark shares her findings.

6:55 How tracking can delay independence

recentItems.title: AI researcher tells Trump 'they're lying to you" after he calls AI fears a 'hoax'
recentItems.description: "They're lying to you." Former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo resigned over safety fears – and now he's responding to President Trump's claim that AI doomsday is a hoax. He tells Erin Burnett if AI development continues unchecked, "we really will have super-intelligent AI by the end of the decade."

recentItems.title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour after 'Free Palestine' remarks
recentItems.description: Rapper and songwriter Macklemore has been dropped from upcoming dates on Ed Sheeran’s stadium tour after several venues allegedly barred him over his onstage “Free Palestine” remarks earlier this month.

recentItems.title: Texas Republican's xenophobic post draws criticism
recentItems.description: Bo French, a Texas Republican running for the Texas Railroad Commission, posted on X what critics described as a xenophobic image targeting Asian students at a UT football game. CNN's Patrick Svitek reports.

recentItems.title: Unvaccinated woman is third measles-related death in Pennsylvania
recentItems.description: A 40-year-old woman who lived in Jefferson County, Pennsylvania, has died from measles complications, the county coroner confirmed Sunday. It's the third measles-associated death in a fast-growing outbreak that's sparked a political clash between state and federal officials. CNN's Jacqueline Howard reports.

recentItems.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump’s plan to limit mail-in voting in midterms
recentItems.description: The Supreme Court rejected President Donald Trump’s bid to limit mail-in voting ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
